where.if: AND ( t.trace_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{traceId}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt at WHERE at.generation_task_id = t.id AND at.trace_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{traceId}, '%') ) )

AND ( CAST(t.id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(t.user_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(t.conversation_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(t.client_message_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(t.error_code, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(t.error_message, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt af WHERE af.generation_task_id = t.id AND af.provider_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{providerKey}, '%') )

AND ( COALESCE(t.model, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt am WHERE am.generation_task_id = t.id AND COALESCE(am.model, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model}, '%') ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id AS id, t.queued_at AS createdAt, t.user_id AS userId, t.client_message_id AS clientMessageId, COALESCE(t.trace_id, '') AS traceId, COALESCE(t.channel, UPPER(t.request_type)) AS channel, COALESCE((SELECT a.model FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id ORDER BY a.attempt_no DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1), t.model, '') AS model, COALESCE((SELECT a.provider_key FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id ORDER BY a.attempt_no DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS providerKey, COALESCE((SELECT a.route_key FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id ORDER BY a.attempt_no DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS routeKey, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id) AS attemptCount, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id AND a.was_fallback = TRUE) AS wasFallback, t.status AS status, c.character_id AS characterId, t.conversation_id AS conversationId, COALESCE(t.duration_ms, 0) AS durationMs, CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS success, COALESCE( t.http_status, CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 200 WHEN t.status IN ('STOPPED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 499 WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 500 ELSE NULL END ) AS httpStatus, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.prompt_tokens, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id), t.prompt_tokens, 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.completion_tokens, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id), t.completion_tokens, 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.total_cost_usd, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.generation_task_id = t.id), 0) AS totalCostUsd, COALESCE(t.error_code, '') AS errorCode, COALESCE(t.error_message, t.error_code, '') AS errorMessage FROM app_generation_task t LEFT JOIN app_conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, generation_task_id AS generationTaskId, request_id AS requestId, trace_id AS traceId, attempt_no AS attemptNo, provider_key AS providerKey, route_key AS routeKey, COALESCE(provider_source, '') AS providerSource, COALESCE(model, '') AS model, byok, was_fallback AS wasFallback, started_at AS startedAt, first_token_at AS firstTokenAt, duration_ms AS durationMs, ttft_ms AS ttftMs, http_status AS httpStatus, status, COALESCE(error_code, '') AS errorCode, COALESCE(error_message, '') AS errorMessage, COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0) AS completionTokens, prompt_tokens_estimated AS promptTokensEstimated, completion_tokens_estimated AS completionTokensEstimated, COALESCE(currency, '') AS currency, total_cost_usd AS totalCostUsd, cost_estimated AS costEstimated, cost_partial AS costPartial FROM app_generation_attempt WHERE generation_task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no ASC, id ASC

sql.where:
a.generation_task_id IS NULL AND a.route_key IN ('vision.default', 'image.default', 'tts.default', 'stt.default') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt newer WHERE a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND newer.request_id = a.request_id AND (newer.attempt_no > a.attempt_no OR (newer.attempt_no = a.attempt_no AND newer.id > a.id)) )
AND a.route_key = CONCAT(LOWER(#{capability}), '.default')
AND a.status = #{status} AND a.started_at >= #{startedAfter} AND a.started_at <= #{startedBefore}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt f WHERE f.generation_task_id IS NULL AND ((a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND f.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND f.id = a.id)) AND f.trace_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{traceId}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt f WHERE f.generation_task_id IS NULL AND ((a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND f.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND f.id = a.id)) AND f.provider_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{providerKey}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt f WHERE f.generation_task_id IS NULL AND ((a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND f.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND f.id = a.id)) AND COALESCE(f.model, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt f WHERE f.generation_task_id IS NULL AND ((a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND f.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND f.id = a.id)) AND f.http_status = #{httpStatus} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt f WHERE f.generation_task_id IS NULL AND ((a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND f.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND f.id = a.id)) AND (CAST(f.id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(f.request_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(f.error_code, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(f.error_message, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )

mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, COALESCE(a.request_id, CONCAT('legacy-', a.id)) AS requestId, COALESCE(a.trace_id, '') AS traceId, CASE a.route_key WHEN 'vision.default' THEN 'VISION' WHEN 'image.default' THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN 'tts.default' THEN 'TTS' WHEN 'stt.default' THEN 'STT' ELSE UPPER(a.route_key) END AS capability, a.attempt_no AS attemptNo, a.provider_key AS providerKey, a.route_key AS routeKey, COALESCE(a.provider_source, '') AS providerSource, COALESCE(a.model, '') AS model, a.byok, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_generation_attempt x WHERE (a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND x.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND x.id = a.id)) AS attemptCount, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_generation_attempt x WHERE ((a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND x.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND x.id = a.id)) AND x.was_fallback = TRUE) AS wasFallback, (SELECT MIN(x.started_at) FROM app_generation_attempt x WHERE (a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND x.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND x.id = a.id)) AS createdAt, (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(x.duration_ms, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt x WHERE (a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND x.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND x.id = a.id)) AS durationMs, a.ttft_ms AS ttftMs, a.http_status AS httpStatus, a.status, COALESCE(a.error_code, '') AS errorCode, COALESCE(a.error_message, '') AS errorMessage, (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(x.prompt_tokens, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt x WHERE (a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND x.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND x.id = a.id)) AS promptTokens, (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(x.completion_tokens, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt x WHERE (a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND x.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND x.id = a.id)) AS completionTokens, (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(x.total_cost_usd, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt x WHERE (a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND x.request_id = a.request_id) OR (a.request_id IS NULL AND x.id = a.id)) AS totalCostUsd FROM app_generation_attempt a
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, request_id AS requestId, COALESCE(trace_id, '') AS traceId, attempt_no AS attemptNo, provider_key AS providerKey, route_key AS routeKey, COALESCE(provider_source, '') AS providerSource, COALESCE(model, '') AS model, byok, was_fallback AS wasFallback, started_at AS startedAt, first_token_at AS firstTokenAt, duration_ms AS durationMs, ttft_ms AS ttftMs, http_status AS httpStatus, status, COALESCE(error_code, '') AS errorCode, COALESCE(error_message, '') AS errorMessage, COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0) AS completionTokens, prompt_tokens_estimated AS promptTokensEstimated, completion_tokens_estimated AS completionTokensEstimated, COALESCE(currency, '') AS currency, total_cost_usd AS totalCostUsd, cost_estimated AS costEstimated, cost_partial AS costPartial FROM app_generation_attempt WHERE generation_task_id IS NULL AND request_id = #{requestId} AND route_key IN ('vision.default', 'image.default', 'tts.default', 'stt.default') ORDER BY attempt_no ASC, id ASC
